venue.details: Selected venue: Hôtel Salomon de Rothschild, 11 Rue Berryer, 75008 Paris (near the Champs-Élysées), a private 19th-century mansion used for weddings and receptions. Advertised capacity: Bridebook lists dining capacity 350 and reception capacity 1,300 (1,300 m² of privatizable indoor spaces; 4,000 m² of gardens), and the Grand Salon accommodates well over 100 guests for a seated dinner (https://bridebook.com/fr-en/wedding-venues/h-tel-salomon-de-rothschild-paris-paris-frV8w0R9Xv; https://www.viparis.com/en/our-venues/hotel-salomon-de-rothschild-en/spaces). This comfortably exceeds the required 100 guests. Genre fit (jazz): a documented wedding at this venue featured a live band blending Parisian jazz, modern hits and North African rhythms (https://www.stylemepretty.com/2025/11/27/a-cinematic-parisian-wedding-at-hotel-salomon-de-rothschild-with-old-world-grandeur). Confirmed date availability for 2027-03-14: NOT confirmed by any source found; the venue is actively marketed for weddings (50+ weddings hosted per Bridebook) and availability for that specific date would require direct booking/confirmation. Advertised capacity is therefore verified, but confirmed date availability is not. Nearby arrival airports for Paris: CDG (Charles de Gaulle) and ORY (Orly); CDG selected as the primary international hub. Note: an alternative candidate, Le Georges at Centre Pompidou (advertised up to 100 guests), was rejected because it closed permanently in September 2025 for museum renovation running to 2030, so it cannot host a March 2027 wedding (https://www.parisselectbook.com/en/2025/03/05/le-georges-is-dead-a-new-page-turns-at-the-centre-pompidou).
